summary: Take the sum over x of lifts of t_x times the idempotent of w, conjugated when b is true; all other terms vanish modulo w.

steps.claim: Witness: y = ∑_x c_b(t̃_x·e_w), where t̃_x ∈ 𝓞_E lifts t_x (the residue map 𝓞_E → 𝔽_w is surjective), e_w ∈ Ô is the idempotent equal to 1 at w and 0 at the other places, and c_b is the involution if b is true and the identity otherwise.
steps.lean:
lemma Filling.exists_reduceAboveG_eq (t : ∀ _, _) : ∃ y, ∀ x, S.reduceAboveG x y = t x := ⟨∑ x,
  cond x.2 star id (surjInv (algebraMap_ResField_surjective _) (t x) • ⟨_, idem_mem_Ô {↑x.1.2}⟩), by

steps.claim: Unfolding reduceAboveG and the sum over the pairs x' = ((i', w'), b'), the reduction of y under x is the sum over x' of the reductions modulo w of c_b(c_{b'}(t̃_{x'} e_{w'})).

Only the term x' = x survives: reduceAt_w(e_{w'}) = 1 if w' = w and 0 otherwise, conj(e_{w'}) = e_{w̄'}, the chosen places are distinct and no conjugate of a chosen place is chosen; the surviving term reduces to t_x.
